search_text: published ZDI-23-1036 ZDI-CAN-20799 Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway DbasSectorFileToExecuteOnReset Exposed Dangerous Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-08-04 CVE-2023-39468 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-39468 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Triangle MicroWorks'] ['SCADA Data Gateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway.
